body.x: WiseJet Co., Ltd. (CEO Chul Soon Park) will attend CES 2025 from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas to showcase its groundbreaking “Wireless CMOS Solution” technology for replacing cables in electronic devices. The company’s vision of a cable-free future has garnered significant attention in the global electronics industry.

WiseJet, founded in 2015 by KAIST researchers, specializes in 60GHz high-speed wireless communication technology. With a team of 21, including top-tier researchers from KAIST and Seoul National University, the company has raised over 10 billion KRW in venture capital, underscoring its growth potential.

WiseJet’s core technology, Wireless CMOS Solution, enables the wireless replacement of high-speed, high-capacity multi-lane cables with a latency of just 7ns and a data transmission speed of 10Gbps per lane. This innovation enhances device assembly and supports slimmer product designs, eliminating the constraints of traditional wired connections.

body.cap: Wireless CMOS Solution Products in Development by WiseJet | Photo by AVING News

body.x: At CES 2025, WiseJet will exhibit across four booths, showcasing cutting-edge wireless transmission solutions applicable to diverse fields. Key highlights include the ability to wirelessly transmit 8K/60Hz ultra-HD video at a range of 10 meters with less than 1 ms latency. This technology incorporates beamforming to avoid obstacles, offering reliability and making cable-free, ultra-slim TV designs feasible.

WiseJet also provides proximity and near-range wireless data and power transmission solutions. These range from millimeter-scale wireless connectors for proximity to video transmission solutions spanning several meters. These innovations can replace traditional connectors in displays, VR/AR systems, and camera inspection equipment, delivering a comprehensive wireless alternative for various industries.

Additionally, WiseJet will debut wireless solutions for AR/VR and medical devices. These include ultra-HD AR/VR video transmission and zero-latency video support for medical equipment, showcasing the adaptability of its technology across applications.
Leading the Era of Hyperconnected Technology for the Fourth Industrial Revolution

High-speed, high-capacity, and ultra-HD data transmission are critical for the Fourth Industrial Revolution. WiseJet’s technology overcomes the limitations of traditional cables and connectors, opening new possibilities in AI, metaverse, and high-performance computing devices.

CEO Chul Soon Park expressed his aspirations: “We aim to create new value and contribute to society by pioneering high-speed wireless transmission technologies for the AI era. We aim to eliminate cables in all electronic devices, achieving an unprecedented transformation.”

body.cap: Demonstration of Cable-Free Ultra-HD Wireless Transmission Technology | Provided by WiseJet

body.x: WiseJet has proven its capabilities through Proof of Concept (PoC) projects with domestic and international clients in robotics, displays, VR/AR, and video walls. At CES 2025, WiseJet will offer global enterprises a chance to experience its transformative technology firsthand, paving the way for a new era of cable-free electronics.
Whether WiseJet can truly revolutionize electronics by removing all cables remains to be seen, but CES 2025 will offer a glimpse into its vision for the future.
